### Model


<iframe id="two-charge-model" src="about:blank" title="Two trapped point charges model" width="100%" height="700" style="border: 0;" loading="lazy"></iframe>
<script>
  const modelFrame = document.getElementById("two-charge-model");
  const inSlides = window.location.pathname.endsWith("/slides.html");
  const modelPath = window.location.pathname.includes("/topics/two_trpapped_pointCharges/")
    ? "model.html"
    : "topics/two_trpapped_pointCharges/model.html";
  if (inSlides) {
    modelFrame.style.height = "65vh";
  }
  modelFrame.src = new URL(`${modelPath}${inSlides ? "?slide-embed" : ""}`, window.location.href).href;
</script>
